source.note: restored copy of a pg_dump of the live database app (Alembic 0002_platform, 11,357 jobs), upgraded to head (p4_0401_match_brief, after the Phase 3 fixes merged); app itself was only dumped

selection.pool_sql: SELECT s.ats::text AS ats, s.token, s.company_name AS company, j.external_id, j.title, j.description, j.location_raw, j.country, j.work_arrangements::text[] AS work_arrangements, j.employment_type_raw AS employment_type, j.department, j.apply_url, j.posted_at, j.materially_changed_at AS changed_at FROM jobs j JOIN job_sources s ON s.id = j.source_id WHERE j.status = 'open' AND j.is_listed AND j.canonical_job_id IS NULL
selection.rule: Postings with an email address or phone number are dropped. The rest are grouped by (source, country) and ordered by the SHA-256 of ats/token/external_id inside each group; the snapshot is the first N of the list sorted by (position inside the group, hash), so it takes one posting from every group, then a second from every group that has one, and so on. N is 1,000 or, if the file would pass 5 MB, the most that fits.

redacted.what: An address written name[at]domain (one role mailbox) that the export filter, which then matched '@' only, let through. The postings were kept and each string replaced in place, so the count and the refs are unchanged. export_snapshot.EMAIL now also matches the [at] and (at) forms: a fresh export would drop these postings instead.
